title: Export Control & Dual-Use Customs Hold Gate
required_invariants: declared_value_usd <= 0 or blank destination_country must raise ValueError.
If destination_country in sanctioned_countries, return decision='blocked_sanctions'.
If is_dual_use and not has_export_license, return decision='compliance_hold'.
If declared_value_usd > 100000 and not dual_signed, return decision='compliance_hold'; else 'cleared'.
